neighbours.label: the predicate start after a generic activity or domain subject in an evaluative claim ('Learning X is so much…', 'Physics education has been…')
fire: Cooking at home is so much cheaper than eating out.
Language learning has become a popular hobby among retirees.
Teamwork definitely makes difficult projects easier.
Gardening is much more relaxing than people expect.
Music therapy has been the focus of several recent trials.
Travelling with children is so much harder than travelling alone.
Public speaking definitely gets easier with practice.
Chemistry teaching has changed a great deal since the 1990s.
quiet: Cooking at home tonight, we made soup and bread.
Language classes start at nine in the main building.
Teamwork posters hung on every wall of the office.
Gardening gloves and seeds are sold at the front desk.
Music therapy sessions take place on Tuesdays in room four.
Travelling with children, we packed snacks and games.
Public speaking clubs meet in the library on Fridays.
Chemistry teachers from three schools met in the hall.

notes: Peak tokens are function words (' is', ' much', ' has', ' definitely') after an abstract subject; the - pole is the 'X is important' slot (logit suppresses important/crucial). Probe mixed: 'so much more' 0.56, 'is crucial' 0.005. Low confidence guess.
